audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagrees with content layer and packet on rows 2-7.
audit.why: Packet levelChart [Hwei, Skill, Ryze, Hwei, Hwei, Ryze, Ryze] matches content whys; 44.65% WR over 1814 games supports the Hwei-leaning early/mid pattern.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned with paired why rewrites.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls Hwei's level-6 spike 'EQ spirit-bolt ult' — his ultimate is Spiraling Despair; QE is Severing Bolt, a basic-ability combo.
audit.why: Packet abilities: R = Spiraling Despair. Calling EQ 'his ult' misinforms the level-6 read.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid, wants.foe[2] corrected to Spiraling Despair / QE Severing Bolt.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names a fabricated ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' in roughly ten fields — his real CC palette is Subject: Torment (E). Packet defect: the page never names his real abilities. Cooldowns field has no digit.
audit.why: Packet abilities: E = Subject: Torment (12s rank 1), W = Subject: Serenity (18s, shield — flagged missing interaction), R = Spiraling Despair (120s).
audit.corrected: Fabricated name replaced with Subject: Torment across winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, cooldowns, feeding, dosFull, report[5] and report[9]; Serenity shield-absorbs-burst interaction added to cooldowns.

edits.before: Survive the range war, hit RoA, and out-combo him for the rest of the game. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Survive the range war, hit RoA, and out-combo him for the rest of the game. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment CC, chaining the signature detonation, and out-ranging you until your tempo starves.

edits.before: - Ryze vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Bank Tear stacks — every Q is a deposit toward the two-item mugging. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Bank Tear stacks — every Q is a deposit toward the two-item mugging. - Engage only on Subject: Torment's 12s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints)
edits.after: Hwei's Subject: Torment (CC)

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Hwei Subject: Torment (E): 12s at rank 1 — all his CC lives on that palette; dodge the root and the burst never chains. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - Subject: Serenity's shield is on an 18s timer — force it out before you commit.

edits.before: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with EQ bounces and stay relevant through Realm Warp plays.
edits.after: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Torment and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with EQ bounces and stay relevant through Realm Warp plays.

edits.before: All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: All his CC lives on Subject: Torment — dodge the root and the burst never chains. Commit on its 12s cooldown, never into it.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: When his Torment palette whiffs he has no CC for 12s — step in, land the E-Q flux trade, and back out before the next QQ.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment's CC — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: W is your only stop button; spent on poke, his next Torment root into the full paint combo goes unanswered for 11s.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment (E): all his crowd control lives on that palette — dodge the root and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your Rod of Ages spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment’s 12s cooldown, on your Rod of Ages spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP feeds the same map plan. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.after: Skill

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes — one more spell each, it comes down to dodges.

edits.before: Hwei
edits.after: Ryze

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks the real combo: root any step-up into a full Flux-Q chain — your first true punish window.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Hwei

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: Tear + Lost Chapter hums, but his WW comet and QW zones poke you under tower safely — answer only on cooldown.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Hwei

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Realm Warp online, but it is macro while Spiraling Despair is a duel spike — shove and warp, never fight his 6.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Ryze

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA/Seraph's spike: mana stops gating your Q chains and trades flip in extended fights. Force what you avoided.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Ryze

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and you out-scale his front-loaded burst: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, Realm Warp ambushes objectives.

edits.before: Hwei's EQ spirit-bolt ult is a real combat and zone spike at 6 while your R is only macro.
edits.after: Hwei's Spiraling Despair at 6 is a real combat and zone spike while your R is only macro.

edits.before: This is Hwei's spike, not yours: EQ spirit bolts execute low targets and his kit has no combat-free window, so don't fight into his full combo and remember your R is macro, not a duel button.
edits.after: This is Hwei's spike, not yours: Spiraling Despair chains his full combo off one hit and QE bolts execute low targets, so don't fight into it — your R is macro, not a duel button.

edits.before: At level 3 you finally get your kit online, and W Rune Prison into a full Flux-Q chain lets you punish any Hwei step-up, which is your one real window. But by 4-5 his WW comet and QW zone control let him waveclear and poke you under tower safely while you can only answer on cooldown. Level 6 is firmly his: EQ spirit bolts are a huge teamfight and burst spike and he can zone objectives, while your R Realm Warp buys map pressure, not kill pressure. Save W for when his slow-zone is down and never facecheck his QE.
edits.after: At level 3 you finally get your kit online, and W Rune Prison into a full Flux-Q chain lets you punish any Hwei step-up, which is your one real window. But by 4-5 his WW comet and QW zone control let him waveclear and poke you under tower safely while you can only answer on cooldown. Level 6 is firmly his: Spiraling Despair is a huge teamfight and burst spike and he can zone objectives, while your R Realm Warp buys map pressure, not kill pressure. Save W for when his slow-zone is down and never facecheck his QE.
